Allow best-in-class engineering capabilities to be replaced without changing canonical workflow semantics or generic Core.
Make every DevRelay run understandable and measurable to a human across any configured number of modules, Gates, adapters, retries, and parallel frontiers.

ContractGeneration [module; conditional]: ContractGeneration produces candidate machine-readable API, schema, event, protocol, data, or other interface contracts only when approved architecture intent requires them.

constraints.statement: Generators propose native contract bytes only; Core owns pinned format validation and canonical diff, while ContractGate owns semantic completeness, compatibility policy, approval, and progression.
constraints.rationale: A generator cannot safely certify its own completeness or authority.
